title: The Journey That Started Something
text: I travelled all the way from Kerala to Bangalore just to prove that I could. It wasn't meant to be about love, but somehow that little ego-driven journey became the moment that set everything else in motion.

title: The Night I Told You
text: The full-night bike ride, the warmth of the night, and the moment I finally confessed my love to you.

title: Thattekad — Mini Switzerland
text: A cool morning at Thattekad. The atmosphere was calm, the grounds felt almost unreal, and we spent the morning being playful together.

title: Four Hours Close
text: Our first time cuddling. We were together for about four hours. But what stayed with me wasn't simply the closeness. My love for you was sincere. It was about you, not just the moment.

title: The First Goodbye
text: I followed your bus till Perumbavoor just to have another twenty minutes with you. When it was time for you to leave, I felt like I was breaking down from inside. But I stood there still, watching you for those last few minutes.
